title: track_codey_job
description: Read-only progress of a Project Codey background job (admin jobs, bulk member checks): jobId (or CJ-... name), or quoteId / tool for the latest job. Returns status, percent done, each step, plain-language errors, the results file link and whether it can resume, as a Progress tracker card. Check about once a minute while running; do not start a second job.

jobId.description: Codey job id or CJ-... name.

quoteId.description: Quote Id or name for its latest job.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
